about.intro: CWBSM turns the small ESP32 CYD screen into a desk information station: world clocks, weather, air quality, Bitcoin and exchange rates, stocks, a calendar (with the Chinese lunar calendar), alarms and timers, internet radio, SD card music / e-books / photos, and TOTP two-factor codes. It speaks 7 languages and works in landscape or portrait.
about.controls: Clock, weather, Bitcoin, stock and air quality pages: tap the left / middle / right third (portrait: top / middle / bottom) for previous page / menu / next page. Calendar, alarm, MFA and calculator pages: taps work the page (calendar days, alarm switches, + and rows, timer buttons); page with the status bar buttons — left ◀ previous, middle menu, right ▶ next (portrait ▲ / ▼). Swipes page everywhere; press and hold anywhere to open the menu, which closes after 5 seconds. BOOT: single click switches apps, double click rotates 90°, hold to clear Wi-Fi and restart setup. A sleeping screen consumes the first touch to wake. On the web preview, click to tap, drag to swipe and hold to open the menu.
about.settings: System settings apply immediately; clocks, weather, currencies, stocks and Wi-Fi use their Save buttons. A new device sets its time zone and weather city from its IP once it is on Wi-Fi. The status bar shows Wi-Fi, IP, NTP sync and the app page. Brightness can be manual, follow ambient light (CYD), follow a schedule or sleep when idle. System can turn modules on and off and offers an MFA-masked screen preview with touch remote; Device maintenance shows memory and CPU, backs up / restores the configuration, recalibrates touch and resets to factory settings.
about.mfa: TOTP uses synchronized UTC time. Enter your PIN on the display to reveal codes. Leaving MFA, sleeping or 2 minutes without interaction locks it. Accounts never rotate automatically. On the locked PIN screen use the top-right Menu button.

about.hardware: Classic ESP32 · 4 MB flash · 320×240 screen · XPT2046 touch. There are four firmwares: the CYD and E32R28T boards, each with an ILI9341 or ST7789 screen; the line above shows this device's firmware version, board and screen controller. The CYD has a light sensor, so brightness can follow the room; the E32R28T has an amplifier. Touch is calibrated on first boot and can be redone from the device gear → System → Display or from Device maintenance.
about.v312: Touch calibration on first boot (and on demand), the device About page shows the screen controller, the web installer lets you choose the write speed, and this page was updated.
about.v311: 10 alarm tones, alarms from SD card MP3s or radio with automatic fallback, time zone and weather from your IP, CYD brightness follows ambient light out of the box, web flashing at 460800.
about.v310: Four firmwares by board and screen, built with ESP-IDF with much more free memory, HTTPS radio stations, and a configurable number of clocks per page.
about.v30: SD card app (music, e-books, photos), web file manager, configuration backup to the SD card.
